claims: The Charlotte Hornets played the Orlando Magic in an Eastern Conference Play-In Tournament game.
The game was on Friday, April 17, 2026.
The game was at 7:30 p.m. ET.
The game was at the Kia Center in Orlando.
The Orlando Magic defeated the Charlotte Hornets 121-90.
The Orlando Magic's victory ended the Charlotte Hornets' season.
The game was streamed on Prime Video.
The Orlando Magic secured the No. 8 seed.
The game was a "win-or-go-home" play-in game.
Paolo Banchero led the Orlando Magic with 25 points.
The results are based on data from April 17-18, 2026.
